mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly describes the graph of the linear equation 2x + 3y = 6 in the xy‑plane?
mcqs.explanation: A linear equation in two variables can be rearranged to the form y = mx + c, which is the equation of a straight line. Hence 2x + 3y = 6 represents a straight line. The other options (parabola, circle, hyperbola) arise from quadratic or higher‑degree equations, not from a first‑degree linear equation.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand solution of a pair as common point
mcqs.question: The pair of equations x + 2y = 5 and 3x - y = 4 have a unique solution (x, y). What does this solution represent when the two equations are drawn on the coordinate plane?

options.A: The distance between the two lines
options.B: The point where the two lines intersect
options.C: The area of the triangle formed with the axes
options.D: The slope of one of the lines

mcqs.answer: The point where the two lines intersect
mcqs.explanation: When two linear equations are plotted, each becomes a straight line. A unique solution means the lines meet at exactly one point; that point’s coordinates are the solution (x, y). Hence the solution is the intersection point. The other options describe unrelated geometric quantities.

mcqs.question: Which of the following pairs of linear equations represent lines that intersect each other at a single point?
mcqs.explanation: Two lines intersect at a single point when their slopes are different. In option B the slopes are -1 and 2, so the lines intersect. Options A and D have equal slopes (parallel lines) and option C represents the same line (coincident), not a single intersection point.

mcqs.question: Which of the following equations represents a line that is parallel to the line 4x - 2y = 6?
mcqs.explanation: The given line can be written as y = 2x - 3, giving a slope of 2. Parallel lines must have the same slope. Equation A simplifies to y = 2x - 5, also slope 2, so it is parallel. Options B, C, and D all simplify to slopes of -2, which are not parallel to the original line.
